name: EntityOptionList
description: The option rows for entity search (the composer's
signature: ({ id, query, options, active, selected, onPick, onActive, empty, className, }: EntityOptionListProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: active
props.description: Marks the current destination or active choice.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: empty
props.description: Content shown when there are no matching items.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: onActive
props.description: Called with the zero-based index of the row under the pointer. Pair with `active` to move the highlight.

props.name: onPick
props.description: Called with the entity the person clicks or presses Enter or Space on; adding or removing the pick is up to the caller.

props.name: options
props.description: The available choices, including their values and visible labels.

props.name: query
props.description: The text being searched for; matches are emphasised.
